title: Image Compressor
aboutText: Large image files can slow down website loading speeds and use up storage. This client-side Image Compressor reduces file size by tweaking JPG/JPEG quality settings using HTML5 Canvas—all directly inside your web browser.
step1Suffix: to upload your image from your device.
step2Suffix: (10% to 100%) to select your compression level.
faq1Q: Are my images uploaded to external servers?
faq1A: No, all compression happens locally on your computer or phone using browser rendering APIs.
faq2Q: What output format is used for compression?
faq2A: Images are converted to JPEG format to achieve maximum file size reduction while preserving clarity.
